data.body:
AC amendment (gap analysis): Harden each awk-scoped assertion to FIRST verify the target section header exists before scanning. Pattern: '_tmp_section=$(awk ...); [[ -n "$_tmp_section" ]] || { fail "section missing"; return; }; echo "$_tmp_section" | grep -q '<literal>'". Prevents vacuous-truth RED-pass (empty extraction trivially fails grep) and silent-GREEN on typo'd section headers.
Verify: grep -qE 'fail .section missing.|section missing' tests/scripts/test-story-decomposer-remediation.sh
